clips.caption:
Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says Aristotle Onassis, once one of the richest men alive, gave one rule for rebuilding wealth from broke: save every penny, then spend it getting into rooms with wealthy people - a nice restaurant, even caddying at a country club just to be near them.

Your income, Kevin says, is the average of your five closest friends.

He took the advice literally. Broke, with no connections, he got a job at a high-end restaurant in a wealthy Massachusetts town for one reason: to be in the room.

Who are the five people setting your average right now?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #successhabits #moneymindset #networking #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend trying to level up sends this to the friend stuck broke: proof that who you sit near can out-earn any resume. Emotion: envy and hope.

clips.caption:
Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says J.D. Rockefeller, who became the richest man in the world, started out earning $1.50 a week. Raised Baptist, he gave 10% of that first paycheck to charity - and kept giving 10% away from every paycheck after, all the way up.

Rockefeller later said that single habit was the real secret to his wealth. By the end of his life, in today's money, he'd given away over $300 billion.

Kevin's point: money you're afraid to lose is money you'll lose. Money given freely comes back.

Would you tithe 10% of $1.50 a week if you knew where it led?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #moneymindset #givingback #successhabits #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend who waits to feel rich before giving sends this to the friend already tithing on minimum wage: proof the habit matters more than the paycheck. Emotion: awe and a little shame.

clips.caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says a man once came to one of his two-day events specifically to manifest a relationship. The man was scared to approach women and knew it was working against him.

After day one, he went to dinner alone. A woman he'd never met walked up, introduced herself, and asked if she could join him - he figured Kevin had set it up. Nobody had.

They hit it off. Both American, neither knew it about the other until later. Kevin's words for it: the universe was conspiring to give him exactly what he wanted.

What are you still too afraid to walk toward?

#kevintrudeau #yourwishisyourcommand #manifestation #lawofattraction #relationships #mindset
clips.send: A single friend who's given up on dating sends this to the friend too scared to approach anyone: proof that naming what you want can make it find you first. Emotion: hope and a little awe.
